## Typography
System sans for controls and body. Wordmark uses the intro's GAIN heavy / FOCUS light treatment. Meal names are 15px; macros 12px.
## Layout
Existing five-tab navigation remains canonical. Nutrition contains Meal planner and Food diary. Two-column mobile meal cards, three columns when space permits. Bottom safe area comes from the app shell.
## Elevation & Depth
Dark translucent panels and subtle borders. The intro alone carries large constellation atmosphere.
## Shapes
16–20px panels. Existing native input controls retained.
## Components
Canonical logo derives directly from intro SVG coordinates. Diary renderer owns food entries. Shadow root scopes legacy meal selectors; it is not an iframe or separate app. Profile/progress remain authoritative stores. Work Fuel preferences are included in progress export.
